answer: No, you don't need a payoff letter. Lakeshore Bank is in our e-payoff network, so we confirm the payoff directly with the lender the same day at your appointment using the loan account number. The lender holds the title while the loan is open, and we pay it off directly from the offer, with any difference going to the seller. The help center doesn't cover selling a car that belonged to someone who has passed away, such as what paperwork or authority you'd need, so please contact a store about that part.
